title: WriteAI Assistant
problem_statement: Writing good content is hard and time-consuming for many people. Whether for work or personal use, people often struggle to express their ideas clearly and efficiently. WriteAI will use artificial intelligence to help users write better content faster, improving productivity across many different use cases.
target_users: Anyone who needs to write content for work or personal use
Business professionals who write emails and reports
Content creators who want to produce more content
user_stories: As a user, I want AI to help me write faster so that I can be more productive
As a business professional, I want to improve my email quality so that I communicate more effectively
As a content creator, I want AI suggestions so that I can generate more content ideas
As a user, I want the AI to fix my grammar and spelling so that my writing looks more professional
acceptance_criteria: The AI should generate helpful and relevant writing suggestions
Grammar and spelling errors should be detected and corrected automatically
The tool should be easy to use and integrate with common workflows
AI-generated content should be appropriate and relevant to the user's input

success_metrics.target: High engagement with AI writing features

risks_open_questions: Competition from existing tools like Grammarly and ChatGPT is very strong
AI-generated content quality may not always meet user expectations
User privacy and data security concerns with AI processing of content
out_of_scope: Features not related to writing assistance
Features planned for later product versions
